requirements.statement: The submission defines the exact top-level parameter and port contract.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The two projected dependencies and submitted wrapper elaborate together without modifying existing files.

requirements.statement: The wrapper structurally instantiates exactly one read and one write dependency with matching public parameter bindings.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Elaborated hierarchy contains both required instances and no replacement implementation.

requirements.statement: AW and W remain independent and pair correctly in either arrival order.
requirements.acceptance_rule: AW-before-W, W-before-AW, and same-cycle requests each produce one matching Wishbone write and one AXI response.
requirements.verification_intent: Directed visible and hidden differential simulation.

requirements.statement: AXI reads preserve address, returned data, order, and response count.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Each accepted AR produces one Wishbone read and exactly one ordered R response with matching data.
requirements.verification_intent: Directed visible and hidden randomized simulation.

requirements.statement: Wishbone write address, data, byte select, and WE are preserved.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Each accepted AXI write pair produces one corresponding Wishbone write beat.
requirements.verification_intent: Visible directed comparison and hidden scoreboard.

requirements.statement: A granted owner retains the external Wishbone bus for its complete internal CYC.
requirements.acceptance_rule: A waiting other requester cannot change external ownership until the selected internal CYC deasserts.
requirements.verification_intent: Stalled and multi-outstanding hidden schedules plus bounded safety assertions.

requirements.statement: Wishbone backpressure preserves a request and cannot corrupt the non-owner.
requirements.acceptance_rule: While stalled, external request fields stay stable; only the selected owner observes acceptance/completion.
requirements.verification_intent: Visible stall stability and hidden independent stall schedules.

requirements.statement: Simultaneous idle requests follow deterministic cycle-level round robin.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Read wins after reset; after each completed owner cycle, the other master wins the next simultaneous idle request.
requirements.verification_intent: Visible reset preference and hidden alternating contention.

requirements.statement: Wishbone errors are routed only to the owner and map to AXI SLVERR.
requirements.acceptance_rule: ERR produces exactly one SLVERR on the matching AXI channel and cannot create a response on the other channel.
requirements.verification_intent: Visible single-channel errors and hidden simultaneous error schedules.

requirements.statement: Synchronous active-low reset clears ownership and pre-reset work.
requirements.acceptance_rule: A sampled low reset suppresses Wishbone requests and no pre-reset AXI response appears later.
requirements.verification_intent: Visible reset smoke and hidden reset-at-stall/outstanding regression.

requirements.statement: Representative legal address/FIFO parameters preserve the contract and unsupported data widths fail statically.
requirements.acceptance_rule: C_AXI_DATA_WIDTH=32 with multiple legal address widths and LGFIFO values elaborates and behaves consistently; any other data width, an insufficient address width, or LGFIFO below one is rejected.
requirements.verification_intent: Hidden address-width/LGFIFO P2P sweep and public invalid-parameter probe.

requirements.statement: The submission remains within one-file additive scope and preserves public/private isolation.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Only rtl/golden12_axil_wb_split_bridge.sv is added; dependencies and notices remain byte-identical and no evaluator asset enters the submission.
requirements.verification_intent: Manifest, digest, path, and symlink checks.

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: read and write internal CYC first assert together after reset
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: read owns the complete first cycle; write remains stalled

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: both request after a completed read-owned cycle
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: write owns the next complete cycle

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: external ACK or ERR while no owner is active
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: neither dependency receives completion and no AXI response is created

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: sampled reset coincides with AXI or Wishbone handshake expressions
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: reset wins and the coincident work is not retained

excluded_claims: One development reference visible run passed on SERVER26; this is not a benchmark PASS or a frozen calibration.

No workflow, timing, area, power, throughput, or PPA claim exists.
